mostWorthwhile.text: Building the decomposition-to-renewal chain was most worthwhile: it connected fungal digestion, nutrient release and uptake by roots to new growth.

leastWorthwhile.text: The run of empty inspections was repetitive and frustrating, especially because the forest and wetland seemed directly relevant to the goals.

surprise.text: I was surprised that rainfall and air were the starting point: their automatic combination made a storm that could supply fallen wood.

arbitrary.text: The initial route felt unclear: several goal-related objects had no available partners until the storm produced fallen wood. The eventual causal link made sense, but finding it involved guessing.

continue.text: Yes. Once the starting point emerged, the interconnected explanations of decomposition, forest rain and carbon storage made further discovery appealing, despite the frustrating opening.
